name: Nordkette
kurzbeschreibung: Towering directly above Innsbruck, the Nordkette mountain range links urban culture with high-alpine Karwendel wilderness at the panoramic Hafelekar viewpoint.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Nordkette (also known as the Inntalkette) forms the southernmost bastion of the Karwendel Alps, creating the world-famous vertical limestone backdrop soaring immediately north of Innsbruck. Nowhere else in the Alps are vibrant urban charm and rugged high-alpine wilderness intertwined so dramatically: in just twenty minutes, visitors can journey from the imperial city centre directly to the Hafelekar (2,334 m)—the acclaimed 'Top of Innsbruck'—via futuristic funicular stations masterminded by star architect Zaha Hadid followed by scenic cable cars. From the jagged crests, an unforgettable dual perspective unfolds: to the south lies the sprawling Inn Valley and Innsbruck's historic rooftops, while to the north stretches the vast, uninhabited Karwendel Nature Park with its sea of limestone crags.

Route & Anforderungen

The Nordkette offers experiences tailored to every mountain lover. Casual visitors and families can stroll along the barrier-free panorama path at Seegrube (1,905 m) or take the short fifteen-minute walk along a paved path from the Hafelekar top station directly to the summit cross of Hafelekarspitze. For ambitious scramblers, the legendary Innsbruck Via Ferrata (Innsbrucker Klettersteig) traces an exhilarating line along knife-edge arêtes toward the Frau Hitt saddle, demanding surefootedness, absolute freedom from vertigo, and full via ferrata safety gear including a helmet. In winter, steep avalanche-controlled gullies like the notorious Karrinne attract elite freeride skiers from across the globe.

Besuch & Anreise

The journey begins directly in downtown Innsbruck at the Congress station. Here, the modern Hungerburg funicular railway whisks passengers over the iconic bridge above the River Inn and past the Alpine Zoo to the Hungerburg plateau, where seamless transfers to the Seegrube and Hafelekar cable cars await. The Hungerburg can also be reached by city bus (Line J) or car. Discounted parking is available in designated garages for cable car ticket holders.

Tipps

Dining at the Alpenlounge Seegrube is an unforgettable highlight; relax on the expansive panoramic sundeck with traditional Tyrolean dumplings while watching paragliders soar against the skyline. Experiencing sunset from the summits reveals the glittering sea of lights across the city of Innsbruck far below.
preis: Free access to trails (Nordkettenbahnen cable cars charge fees)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; cable cars operate daily (brief maintenance closures spring/autumn)
